newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Jan 8.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Manila Standard says fugitive Zamboanga del Norte congressman Romeo Jalosjos has been spotted by pursuing lawmen in a secluded island off the coast of Dipolog city.
- Malaya says President Fidel Ramos cites the bravery of nine-year old Rhona Mahilum who singlehandedly saved her four brothers and sisters from their burning house.
- Philippine Daily Inquirer quotes finance secretary Roberto de Ocampo saying he will run for the presidency in 1988 should President Fidel Ramos ask him to.
- Manila Bulletin says the Department of Labour and Employment reported that dollar remittances from overseas Filipino workers were expected to hit a record $7.5 billion this year.
- BusinessWorld says the Central Bank is looking at the possibility of reducing further banks' reserves requirements considering the slowdown in inflation rate.
- Philippine Star says the government is considering scaling down the 1997 inflation target to 5.0 percent from 6.5 percent.
- Philippine Business Daily says the Senate wants to review the compromise forged by the bicameral conference committee over the proposed 40 percent cut in the countrywide development funds.
